text: Fees The tuition fee is 20,000 RMB per person per year. The students without receiving the Pre-master Courses need to pay the application service fee 20,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: recommendation letter arranged by the university, guidance to studying abroad in China, selection of majors, proof materials for personal Chinese language level, and completion of relevant procedures etc.). During the preparatory study or after the payment of the application service fee, the university will accomplish the formal application procedures of direct admission for international applicants between April 1st and June 30th each year. Accommodations Students will live in the International Students’ apartments arranged by the university. All the admitted students will get the scholarship, which will be used to reduce the accommodation expenses. The accommodation fee is only 900 RMB per student per year.
